onboardingIntro: A few things and you are ready to start getting work.
onboardingBasicBody: Your city and PIN code, so we can find work near you.
onboardingTradeBody: The trade you mainly work in.
onboardingSkillsDoneBody: Your main trade counts as one. Open this to add every other trade you work in.
onboardingSkillsBody: Add every trade you work in. You are not limited to one.
onboardingAreaBody: How far you are willing to travel for a job.
onboardingKycBody: A government ID. Customers are letting you into their homes.
onboardingReviewNotice: Once you have finished these, our team checks your documents. You can carry on setting up your services while you wait.
onboardingTradesLoadFailed: Trades could not be loaded. Try again.
onboardingMainTradeBody: You can add more trades afterwards.
onboardingTravelBody: We will only offer you jobs within this distance of where you are right now.
onboardingTravelCentre: We use your current location as the centre point. You can change this any time from your profile.
onboardingLocationOff: Turn on location access to set your work area.
notificationsStayOff: Notifications stay off. You can turn them on in your phone settings.
notificationsPrimerTitle: Get told when a job comes in
notificationsPrimerBody: Job offers expire. A notification is how you hear about one while the app is closed — nothing else is sent.
